papers.title_en: Design and optimization of an AZO-based plasmonic metasurface-driven optical solar reflector for thermal management
papers.authors: Lucas Viseur, Alexandre Mayer, Luc Henrard, Michaël Lobet
papers.evidence: 使用铝掺杂氧化锌(AZO)作为透明导电氧化物层构建等离激元超表面
papers.tldr: 随着深空探测和卫星星座发展，航天器热控系统对轻量化、高效太阳反射镜的需求日益迫切，传统方案因厚度和重量问题难以满足。等离激元超表面驱动的光学太阳反射镜(m-OSR)利用亚波长金属-介质结构激发局域表面等离激元，在极薄厚度内实现太阳光谱低吸收与热红外高发射。本文提出一种由铝背反射层、二氧化硅间隔层和纳米结构掺铝氧化锌(AZO)层组成的m-OSR，其选择性源于反射、局域等离激元共振和法布里-珀罗腔效应的协同。通过多目标遗传算法对周期、直径等参数优化，获得太阳吸收率α=0.16、热发射率ε=0.83，α/ε比低至0.19，厚度仅为亚微米量级。该设计展示了AZO等离激元超表面在下一代航天器热控中的巨大潜力，有望替代传统厚重反射镜，为轻量化热管理提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Plasmonic metasurface-driven Optical Solar Reflectors (m-OSRs) offer a promising route towards lightweight and high-performance thermal management. By exploiting subwavelength structuring and intrinsic material losses, such systems enable tailored absorptance spectrum across the solar and thermal infrared domains, respectively. Here, a plasmonic m-OSR composed of an aluminum back-reflector, a silicon dioxide dielectric spacer, and a nanostructured aluminum-doped zinc oxide (AZO) layer is investigated. The optical response of the structure is governed by the interplay between reflection, localized surface plasmon resonances and Fabry-Perot cavity effects, leading to efficient spectral selectivity. An optimization performed with a multi-objective genetic algorithm yields a low solar absorptance of alpha = 0.16 combined with a high thermal emissivity of epsilon = 0.83, providing an alpha/epsilon ratio of 0.19. These results highlight the potential of plasmonic meta-OSRs as ultrathin, high-performance solutions for thermal management and in particular for the next-generation advanced spacecraft.
